headline: Professional codecs, audio repair, Team seats and projects that move
notes: H.264 and H.265 encoded frame by frame — faster than real time, and the tab can go in the background.
Apple ProRes 422 and Avid DNxHR from the desktop app, with no extra licence to buy.
Studio audio repair: spectral noise reduction, mains-hum removal, click repair and automatic levelling.
Team edition — three people, one payment, and the three-seat limit is enforced on the server.
Project bundles carry your footage with the edit, so a project opens intact anywhere. It is also just a ZIP.
Automatic 540p proxies for smooth editing on older machines. Export always uses the original.
Variable-frame-rate phone video and screen recordings open without converting anything first.
The cloud AI retries, then falls back to the on-device planner, so an outage costs seconds and nothing else.
